# Golden installer fixtures

`golden.json` is what the **TypeScript** installer (`packages/init`,
retired by this port) actually wrote. It was generated by running that
implementation's `installMcp` / `installCommands` over a scratch tree for
every one of the 30 registry entries — twice for JSON MCP hosts, the
second time into a config that already contained a foreign server and an
unrelated top-level key, so the merge behaviour is pinned and not just
the happy path.

Shape: `{toolId: {tool, files: {relativePath: content}}}`. Skill-bundle
files are excluded — that install is a verbatim recursive copy of
`skills/novamem/`, not installer-rendered output.

Fixture parameters: base URL `https://memory.example.com`, bearer
`nm_GOLDENFIXTURETOKEN`, shim version `9.9.9`.

These fixtures are the parity oracle for the Go port, with one
documented exception: per ADR 0001 npm is no longer a distribution
channel, so where the fixtures show a stdio entry invoking
`npx -y @azrtydxb/novamem-mcp@9.9.9`, the Go installer writes the path of
the shipped `novamem-mcp` binary and no `args`. The integration test
applies exactly that substitution and nothing else.

The generator cannot be re-run once `packages/init` is deleted; that is
deliberate. The fixtures record a behaviour that no longer has a second
implementation, which is the whole point of keeping them.
